questions.default: Least significant byte first, bit 0 first within each byte, which matches the Ethernet wire order of a little-endian byte stream

questions.answer: Least significant byte first, bit 0 first within each byte, which matches the Ethernet wire order of a little-endian byte stream

questions.text: A DATA write and a CTRL clear in the same clock: which takes effect
questions.default: CTRL clear takes priority and the DATA word is discarded, so crc_state reads 0xFFFFFFFF
questions.reason: The request does not define the conflict and a single winner keeps the model unambiguous
questions.answer: CTRL clear takes priority and the DATA word is discarded, so crc_state reads 0xFFFFFFFF

questions.text: Can the shell issue a DATA write on every clock back to back
questions.default: Yes, every accepted write updates crc_state in its clock with no wait states

questions.answer: Yes, every accepted write updates crc_state in its clock with no wait states
